note: Issue #43: Hyper3D ships and speeder, prepped by tools/look/prep_vehicle.gd into assets/vehicles/. Rodin models come out nose toward +Z, so yaw_deg 180 turns them to the game's -Z. length is nose to tail in metres; max_span keeps a ship inside its pit bay (9.4 x 8.2 m, turned 90 degrees, so length <= 9.2 and span <= 8.0). Generation ids are in `generations`.
